products.name: Arthur AI
products.note: Model monitoring and governance; bias mitigation; fairness metrics; compliance reporting

profile_text.body:
Arthur AI is a technology company that provides an AI governance and monitoring platform aimed at enterprise organizations. The company describes itself as offering a unified control plane that brings together security, finance, and AI-building teams to measure, monitor, and govern AI systems at scale. Its platform is designed to cover the full AI lifecycle, spanning traditional machine learning models, generative AI, and agentic systems, and is presented as model-, framework-, and use-case-agnostic.

The company's core product, also called Arthur AI, encompasses model monitoring, observability, guardrails, bias mitigation, fairness metrics, and compliance reporting. Arthur positions the platform as serving both governance and security teams, who use it to discover and apply organization-wide policies, and engineering and product teams, who use it across what the company calls the Agent Development Lifecycle. Customer testimonials on the site claim the platform serves as a single solution for model monitoring needs and that one user expected it to reduce their maintenance workload by 50 percent.

The held facts confirm Arthur AI maintains a tracked product presence in the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
